lines: Oh, where did you come from?
Pardon me, it's just that these ruins are so fascinating!
I can hardly take my eyes off the details of this statue here!
Truly captivating!
The people building these ruins most certainly must have been proficient builders!
The details, the forms, all of it is astonishing!
Just think what they could have built if they lived today!
This statue has great detail to it, but it is merely a homage to the Babe of legend.
I have not yet uncovered what the actual Babe looks like...
I found this enormous painting on one of the walls recently!
It depicts a great structure, stretching way up in the clouds.
The cloud means that they had developed flying technology,
and the structure means that they built their own wings!
I have found some etchings clearly illustrating a wave of water.
The people living here were very fond of taking long swims with their pet fish!
I find it very peculiar to bathe with your pet fish...
It's bizarre to own a pet fish at all if you ask me!
Amongst the ruins are engravings that depict people swimming in water, next to a large structure.
This civilization had entire buildings containing massive bodies of water,
just so they could bathe whenever they felt like!
There are glyphs in the ruins describing the history of this place.
I recently deciphered a text that had some words lost through the tear of time and weather.
"...fear...wrath...structure...water...ruin!"
If you fill in the holes you'll get this:
In fear of the wrath of the fishes, we built big structures filled with water for them! Doing this saved us from ruin!
Finally the solution to the riddle. That's why they built all those bath houses!
It just came to my attention that this statue here is missing its head!
A very interesting artistic decision to build it without a head.
Excuse me, but I have to get back to my studies of this marvelous artifact!
I can not stop thinking about this statue here!
It is a representation of the Babe, but why did they build it without a head?
Puzzling...
According to to recent findings it has become clear that the civilization here started to build a tower-like structure.
However, the building process was halted, so the tower was never completed.
The people living here were obsessed with water!
But all the water in this area dried out.
This caused them to abandon the area.
Yes, yes. I can sense it, I'm nearing a breakthrough!
Any moment now!
Aha!
No wait... That's not it... Any time now though!
Ooh, I think I found something new!
Let me check!
Yep! That is definitely something I have not seen before!
Please wait a minute would you!
I am in the middle of a breakthrough in my research!
You look funny!
Hahaha!
Hey, why do you jump up?
Stay here more and play!
You look like a fish!
Because you're blue!
Hihihi!
Stay a while longer!
Never leave this place!
You will play with us for a while longer!
Forever longer!
Haha! You're back again!
Where did you go?
Oh! Oh!
Friend?
Friend!
What is your favorite color?
Mine is green!
Hihi!
I'm so happy!
Friend, pal, my buddy!
Hello there heh heh!
I haven't seen you around here before!
If you are anything like the others, this might just make for a good show!
Hehehe!
New jumpers like you are so much fun!
You still know nothing!
Go on!
Get back up there again!
I'd like to watch you fall some more!
Hehehehe!
Aaahh... That sound is like music to my ears!
But I think it would be even better if you put even more force into your falls!
Well done, still! Hahahahah!
I've been sitting in this cage here for a while!
But I can't leave now!
Not while you are still around to amuse me!
Hehehahaha!
Watching you fall over and over...
It makes me feel so blessed!
Fall for me more! Heheheh!
You remind me of a funny thing that happened here once!
This guy tried to jump here too, just like you!
Wanna know what happened?
He fell on the exact same spot twice in a row! Hahahahah!
Good, don't think too much! Just jump!
And fall!
Alright, alright!
Tell me when you will make a serious attempt!
Hahahah!
It doesn't matter how many times I see you fall!
This will never get old!
The last guy that was here was done by now!
Was he fast, or are you just slow?
Probably the latter!
That the stuff, just like I want it!
C'mon now, don't stop!
People usually don't stay for long!
But it seems like you are enjoying yourself!
You don't have to worry about me, I'm having a blast, too!
SPLART! SPLURT! SPLOFF! SPLAT!
Heheheheheh!
That's the sound of you falling!
I will never get enough of this!
Hahahahaha!
Don't tell me you were actually jumping seriously this whole time?
I almost feel sorry for you...
But not really! Heheheheh!
Hah, I would give that last one a 7 out of 10!
It had a good resonance to it!
Hahahahehe!
Watching you fall over and over never gets old!
It feels like I've watched you for quite some time now! Heheheheh!
But I haven't had enough yet!
Thank you please continue!
Hehehehe!
I hope you're not about to give up!
I'm not done watching you!
Hahaha!
It's more fun to see you jump when you actually try!
It makes the fall more emotional, you know?
I do like your company!
So, continue with what you were doing, I don't mind!
I could watch you fall for an eternity without getting bored!
Please, try to prove me wrong!
Hehehe!
Hehehe!
Have you ever tried not to fall on your face?
Never mind!
It is funnier for me when you do!
Hahahahehe!
I have waited so long for you to return!
Ahh, I already feel better!
Hehehehe!
Nice view from here!
I do like your company!
So, continue with what you were doing! I don't mind!
Please!
Entertain me! Heheheh!
Hmm?!
A fellow jumper? How unusual.
I salute you for coming this far, but I am afraid this is the end of the road for us.
Just wait until you see what is ahead.
I will wait here.
When I first started there was another also attempting.
Needless to say he didn't get as far.
You may as well give up.
The path ahead is impossible to traverse.
Those jumps in the storm up there?
Not humanly possible.
I have studied the movements of the wind.
It defies logic.
If we can not reach the top.
How could a lady ever do it?
The thick snow prohibits calculated leaps.
I came upon a peddler of so-called "magic boots" once.
He never offered a shred of evidence of their supposed abilities.
That conman must have taken me for a fool.
If no one has been to the top,
then where would the legend come from?
Why do you even try?
We will never reach the top.
People say those statues give bad luck.
Foolish superstition.
If she really was at the top -
would someone not have found her by now?
Face it. We will never see her.
She is as real as a fairy or a ghost.
Who could live in such harsh conditions?
No, a lady could never live up there.
There is no proof that she exists.
Above the storm?
Do not make me laugh.
A chapel?
I never expected you to be a liar.
Disappointing.
You shall never make it to the babe of legend.
Even if you succeeded, she would refuse you.
You are doomed to fail. I read it in your soul.
For you are an insignificant, small and ugly creature.
Written in destiny is this:
Man shall reach the peak of his ability, but no further.
You are at your limit, it is not your destiny to reach the top.
Your childish struggle - should you continue - will gain you nothing but misery and regret.
Your kind came from the mud.
Man was made to grovel in the dirt of his ancestors.
Your pursuit of flight, it is unnatural.
You seek my advice yet again?
I shall let you in on a secret.
Your blood is not that of a King.
Return to the pit from where you first crawled out.
Birds fly,
Fish swim,
Men fall.
All men are not made from the same fibre...
You have reached the end of your path.
Go back now, to your roots in the underworld.
A man who believes he is winged and free -
is a man who will always fall.
Your miserable delusions will cost you dearly...
Wings are made for flying.
Feet are made for crawling.
It seems you are blind to the discrepancy between Bird and Man.
Birds fly, Men do not.
Why then, do you persist?
You have heard the legend too?
So you're gonna get that babe, right?
Go on then, get up there!
Heh, heh, heh...
She must really be something...
A beauty, I'm sure!
Heh, heh, heh...
Why did you stop jumping?
Go on, get back up there!
Heh, heh, heh...
I look up from time to time!
Soon I will get a glance!
Hee, hee, hee…
Your tent is looking pretty comfortable there...
Am I right?
Heh, heh, heh...
What do you eat, anyway?
I prefer the delights of this here bog!
Hoh, hoh, hoh...
...her ... hmm...
...mumble ... what? ... eeh...
...what then ... eeh ...
...in the air ... hmm ...
...mumble ... mumble ... oh yes ...
...what if ... humn...
...eeh ... eat ...
...yes of course ... mumble ... eeh ...
... hmm ... so high up ...
... Where was I ... Ahh yes!
I caught a fairy the other day!
You want a peek?
TOO BAD!
Heh heh heh...
Good day!
I reached the babe once!
It must have been her...
How do you feel?
I'm feeling good!
Hee, hee, hee...
Oh, I wish that I was young again!
Then I would reach the babe in no time!
Oh yes...
There is a nice and safe place just above the tree!
Heh, heh, heh...
Unlike you, I learned from my mistake!
I never tried again!
Hee, hee, hee...
I still hope to get a glance of her!
A man can dream!
Hee, hee, hee...
I'll give it another go!
Right after this nap...
Why you should continue?
Did you forget about the babe already?!
Heh, heh, heh...
You should just give up!
No, wait...
I believe you will make it!
Heh, heh, heh...
So I... Borrowed... this potion from a merchant,
I think it gave me special powers!
Hee, hee, hee...
That helmet seems to come in handy!
Or is it your thick skull that cushions you when you fall?
Hee, hee, hee...
What is the colour of her hair?
The leaves on that tree are red!
Hmm...
Could you bring me some of those red leaves?
I like them more than the green ones!
Hoh, hoh, hoh...
The sewers are so clean!
You could probably eat from the floor even!
Yeah, I could see myself living there!
I know, I'll go there! ... Tomorrow...
Have you seen the flowers on top of the tree?
Don't you think they smell good?
Hee, hee, hee...
Once I jumped so high that I almost got to the babe in one leap!
That's right!
Heh, heh, heh...
You probably reached your peak anyways!
Heh... Yep!
There is a huge cabin above the sewers!
Shouldn't be too hard to get through!
Hee, hee, hee...
Is that mud on your face?
...or something else?
Hee, hee, hee...
Have you seen her yet?
Pah! Didn't think so!
Heh, heh, heh...
She probably has a great chest -
full of treasure!
Hoh, hoh, hoh...
You seem to have been through a lot of crap!
Heh, heh, heh...
I heard the big house is haunted...
Yeah, I saw a ghost there myself!
You better watch out!
Hoh, hoh, hoh...
I'm just taking a break at the moment!
You should too!
Heh, heh, heh...
I once caught a whiff of her!
It must have been her...
Hee, hee, hee...
If I were you I'd avoid that old castle, too risky in there!
You should take the shortcut outside!
Heh, heh, heh...
I heard someone fall at least a 100 times!
Glad it wasn't me!
Heh, heh, heh...
I remember some beautiful meadows above the fort!
Ah yes, flowery fields...
Hmm...?
How nice it was, to walk in those fields.
If it wasn't for my age I'd be up again in no time!
Hee, hee, hee...
I bet the top is right above the flowery meadows!
The babe cannot be much farther than that!
Hoh, hoh, hoh...
What are you going to do?
Cry maybe?
Heh, heh, heh...
Instead of falling down,
have you thought about jumping up?
Heh, heh, heh...
I haven't seen that magpie for a while now!
Pity, it would have made for a good meal...
Heh, heh, heh...
You remind me of this really sour guy that passed by once!
Apparently he had “calculated” a “strategy” to get the babe!
He probably gave up too...
Er, I mean, took a break!
(phew!)
His “strategy” to get the babe?
It was something foolish like...
Er...
“Not fall”
Not very smart if you ask me!
I came up with a new strategy to get to the babe!
Just don't fall!
Hoh, hoh, hoh...
Ring the bell on the northern tower thrice, and your deepest wish is granted!
Or was it four times?
It's all the same to you, right?
Heh, heh, heh...
Have you been to the carnival yet?
So many fun attractions!
Heh, heh, heh...
What's that behind you?
So you're bringing ghosts with you down here now huh?
What is your problem? Hmm?
I have my right, you know!
Ah...
Another innocent victim of her deceptive scheme...
How typical...
Well, you should get comfortable like the rest of us right away.
Unless, of course, you are less intelligent than I had hoped.
Believe me, this is paradise compared to what you are chasing.
Come to your senses!
Stay here a while and you will understand everything...
There will never be a day of retribution.
Stop entertaining your false ideas of hope.
The Babe and her kind are vile creatures.
And you would do well to get that into your skull.
I have seen it all.
I saw when they halted time itself to keep this charade going.
I saw the mold fester and grow while she didn't move a finger.
I have seen it all, and you are no different from all those other fools.
That wench gives us these glimpses of hope.
But the nasty witch knows we will never reach her.
It doesn't matter to her!
She gets a kick out of putting gentlemen like you and me down like this...
Us, reaching the Babe?
Hah! Nonsense...
And she knows it!
Damn it... Curses be upon her!
I'm perfectly happy without that witch!
It is rational to stay here.
I don't need her...
It was no defeat, it was merely the logical course of action...
Ah, yes.
You think the world is just?
Hah, I used to be naive too.
Look at the decay and rot of this world, and dare tell me I am wrong?!
She has been doing this forever.
Luring completely innocent people like us into struggling for her!
She knows where we will end up in the end.
How many have suffered the same fate?
Dozens? Hundreds? Thousands...
I was once like you, so innocent...
Until I realised the truth about that wench.
You fool, don't you understand she enjoys this?
Still struggling I see.
She will not be worth it...
Clear your mind! Have a lie down in the mud. Embrace it.
Then you will see the light, like I did.
All Babes are the same...
You think I am miserable? Unhappy?
No!
I thrive here... I am free!
You curse yourself for falling into this bog?
Stop it.
You know the Babe is to be blamed for this.
Why don't you have a seat right over there?
It is much more comfortable than blindly chasing a lie, you know.
Stop your delusional struggle already, the truth is right here!

Behold boys, another loser on the way to disappointment!
Lookin' for aught in the way of Smoking hot Babes?
Hahaha!
I hate to break it to thee, amigo, but thou got played for a fool!
Hahaha!
Aye? We know it's cool lookin' alright! 'Tis our turf!
We were 'bout to lose it 'cos of this pesky torrent of water.
Twas someone tryna mess with our joint!
Thou know we had to stop time itself to keep our spot!
Now we be kickin' back eternally! Right boys?
Hahaha! Yeah! They ain't messing with us no more, man!
Thou clambered all the way here 'cos of the old ghost story?
Hahaha!
Thou know 'tis a hoax, right? She's been messing with thee!
If some sod enters our turf unbidden, we usually toss 'em back in the bog!
But we shan't bother thee.
Cos it seems thou wanna do it thyself!
The Queen is a beauty... but she ain't my Queen!
Or is she? Nay, man... Hahaha!
Or perhaps..?
She is a sly cat, that Queen lady...
Messin' with people like that. People like thine own self, dawg!
Unless thou already knew?
Hahaha! Boys, look at his face! Of course he didn't!
The water got frozen in time, but thou can still drink it.
Or take a leak in it!
Hahaha!
Thou didn't drink any, right?
Y'see these wings?
We can swiggity swoop wherever we desire, dawg!
We art godlike!
Tis the only reason we need. Stick to the mud, little guy!
Damn, I'm cool! Someone ought to build a huge statue of me!
At least as huge as that bald fellow yonder!
Hahaha! Yeah!
What art thou doing here, amigo?
Don't thou belong down in the bog?
Hahaha! Mud man!
You lost, little man?
The exit is down there! Come again!
Hahaha!
Thou gotta be jesting me! A mudman like thyself, reaching the Queen?
How art thou gonna get up there without wings, man?
What up, little guy?
Art thou still tryna get to the Queen?
She be crying right now, I'd wager...
With laughter!
Hahaha! Mud men never learn do they fellas?
Hey watch thy jumpin'! Thou art asking to get time frozen, punk!
Hahaha! I'm kidding, I'm kidding!
Why thou gotta be taking everything so seriously, little man!

Try to hold your breath when you're out there.
The air is not so good to breathe.
This place is cursed.
You'd do best to avoid sticking around for too long.
I don't really feel like moving.
Besides, my skin has hardened and turned into stone.
You'll turn into an old man before you know it.
We've been like this forever though.
When you're gone we will probably still be sitting right here.
Hello. This is my room...
I'm getting tired just looking at you.
Can you please leave?
The wind is getting inside...
But it's too much work to seal the entrance.
My back is itching... but I can't reach it!
Or maybe I could, but I'd have to move my arm around my back.
I'd rather sit still...
I take it you're trying to get to the Babe?
I used to be like you...
Could you please stop looking at me?
You are making me uncomfortable.
Doing anything is such a hassle...
I've been sitting here for a while now.
Don't really have any reason to move...
The Babe?
I mean, sure, I would like to reach her.
But I don't really feel like trying.
You understand, right?
I better open my eyelids...
I think they're gonna get stuck like this if I don't open them...
But it's kinda bright outside, you know? It could sting if I opened them.
Oh, hi.
Watch out for the wind, friend.
If you fall down, try not to land on the right side.
You'll probably fall further than on the left side.
I used to be the top tactician.
Staking out the correct place to jump, stuff like that.
I don't really feel like attempting anymore, ever since we got cursed.
I'll gladly give you tips though.
I know this town inside out.
Right here, you wanna jump to the right side.
Try doing a full jump to the right. You won't regret it.
You can thank me later.
Did you know there is a secret jumping strategy in the wind?
Try jumping straight up. The wind will carry you to the side.
I actually invented that technique myself.
Hello.
I don't think you're supposed to be here...
Or was it someone else that wasn't allowed?
I'm supposed to keep a look-out.
I think there's some really bad guys that want to come here.
Or was there? Maybe that was just a hypothetical situation...
Did you go through here earlier?
Come closer so I can take a look at your face.
No, the other guy didn't look like you.
They said he had a blue helmet.
Did you talk to my brother?
He's over there in that other house.
We are supposed to keep a look-out here, but I'm the only one doing any work.
He's so useless, my brother.
He's just sitting there...
By now we are supposed to patrol the area.
Me? I'm taking my break, it's his shift now.
If he would just straighten up...
I have stomach problems, you know?
If he could just take my shift when I have to take an emergency break we could do our jobs fine.
The Babe?
Don't be ridiculous! We have to keep watch here.
I would like to, but I just can't.
Oh...! Hail to you, little spirit.
The Mountain King is who I am.
You see, from here I can just about watch over my whole kingdom.
All through the world my realm reaches.
From the little fairies playing around in the moss below...
...all the way to the mountain stones up above.
But I recognise you not.
From where did you come?
Go down and play with the fairies, why not?
Always looking for someone to play with they are.
If you do, stop nagging me they might.
Feast your eyes upon my wealth and splendor!
Is there a grander hall in this world? I think not,
for my kingdom is the world.
It is I the all-mighty Mountain King,
and a kind ruler I am.
Indeed, at the expense of the court I provide my subjects with some mushrooms once every now and then.
A charitable King, am I not?
Through my kingdom I enjoy strolling, and mostly in the mountain stones.
When to the fairies down below I wander they become a bit too excited.
Always they seem to think that I want to play with them.
Can they not find someone else, I ponder?
Did you know my kingdom the biggest in the entire world is.
Of course it is so, for my kingdom is the only kingdom.
The greatest King, that makes me!
Each and every subject in my kingdom I appreciate.
And like me back they do.
Understand through this that I am a good King.
What think you of my kingdom, little one?
Quite impressive, is it not?
Ask anyone in the world you could, who the most gentle, modest and biggest king is.
Each and every one you asked the same answer would give you.
It is I!
No one greater there is in this world, you see.
Quite a small little creature you are.
But never seem you to stop jumping around.
From where do you get all that vigor?
Did I ever to you sing the story of how the greatest King became me?
No?
Well, brag I'd rather not.
One of my subjects shall have to tell you sometime.
Through all of my kingdom you have been?
Quite a travel to make, little one.
Not everyone has the stamina for a journey such as that.
Oh, it is you again.
How is it that sometimes I feel not your presence?
As if you disappear from the world.
Up and down you jump, all over the world.
Where are you going, little one?
The greatness of my kingdom behold with awe.
For I, the King, am equally as monumental.
Like you The fairies seem to do.
Never they want to stop playing with you, they sing to me.
Hey!
It's not every day you see a new face around here!
What I'm doing here?
I'm trying to sell these huge boots I've got to some passing giant or troll...
They don't fit me, so I figured why not try to make a quick buck instead of throwing 'em out?
What, you want 'em?
That's funny! They probably won't fit you, but I won't stop you from buying 'em!
I'd say I could get [gold_count] silver for them from any troll. So that's gonna be the price!
The top way to make easy money is to take garbage and make it look fancy!
People don't seem to have an eye for quality, but I do.
It's easy to up the value of an item.
You just gotta make people believe it's the quality stuff!
It's not lying if you just leave some blanks for 'em to fill in, right?
One night I had too much to drink and traded my horse for a lonely tree!
Worst deal ever is what I thought - until there a man in need of taking a leak walked by!
Traded him the tree for 5 gold!
Not too shabby if you ask me!
Wanna know the secret to fast cash?
One word:
Trade chains.
I started with an old spoon, and look at me now!
At this pace I'm gonna be living in a grand mansion soon. Oh yeah!
If you want to sell a bottle of water, all you have to do is to take a piss in the water reservoir.
That's what I call monopoly.
Say you can get an apple for 1 copper from your local farmer.
What happens if all of the apples suddenly disappear?
What happens is apples are now in high demand.Eh, you follow me?
What I'm trying to say is that I made a fortune by picking the trees clean of apples in an entire region,
and then selling them as an exclusive rarity. Heh heh!
I traded some ham for a whole piece of gold the other day.
Best deal I've made in a long time!
Such a smooth trade it was - Magpies are easy to deal with!
Wanna know how to sell something that is overpriced?
The key is how you present your offer.
How come two bottles of milk can have a different price?
Because people think that one of them is of greater quality, yeah.
I'm not a liar buddy... people simply don't ask the right questions.
It's tough, but in business you gotta avoid telling them what they don't want to hear.
Be selective about your facts, that's all! Heh!
Trolls are pretty gullible. Just show them something shiny and they will buy it.
Don't look at me like that, they only have themselves to blame, not me!
I just give them what they want. Yeah.
Greetings!
These boots are fit for a legendary hero!
Crafted by a distinguished master, with these you'll get to that babe in no time!
Since I like you I'll cut you a deal...
For only [gold_count] measly gold, they are yours!
What do you say, eh?
It appears there aren't many other customers around...
You don't happen to have any rich friends?
I wonder if there is hidden treasure in any of these houses...
...the owners are probably long dead, right?
I'm going out of business unless I can sell these boots!
I came here to offer my wares,
but it seems as though the clientele is quite limited!
Hey, pal!
Have you seen Ghost Lady?
She is held captive by demons at The Top, but she visits me in spirit!
Yes! She is my wife!
She comes every day, motivating me to save her!
She leaves these fragments for me! I just can't get enough of them!
Help me find more! I will give you my shoes!
I think... [gold_count] of her fragments should be enough to last a while!
Oh! Almost time for our date! If you would give us some privacy please?
I can't believe those demons! Nasty demons!
Why! Why hold MY wife hostage?
I hate them!
I have to save her! I love her!
I will save you Ghost Lady! From the evil demons!
But I'd like to prepare some more first...
Just a couple more times before I venture up there...
Wait my love! I'm coming for you!
I have an idea!
What if, you go save my wife - and I wait for her to appear here again!
I can let her know I have arranged for her rescue! It will be perfect!
Did you see my beloved up there?
I must ask that you don't get too close to her.
She is very shy! I'm sure she would be too embarrassed and hide!
Give her some time, brother! She'll warm up to you, too!
I feel sorry for you, since you don't have a wife like me!
You are missing out, pal!
Ohoh!
Living the daily life like this is the dream!
I only get to see her ghost, you say? Well that is enough for me!
I might just settle down here!
You and I are so much alike, we always fall!
Although I fall for my wife! Ohoh!
Ahh... You're back! Did you see my wife up there? She is wonderful!
It's been a while now since I last saw her!
She should be here any minute now!
I can hardly wait! Mmmh! Ahhh!
Hey pal!
I feel like our friendship has really started to blossom!
Please scratch my head! I will ask my wife to introduce you to her sister!
Think about it, we could be brothers in law!
Right, brother!?
You and I are so alike!
Except I have a wife! I love her!
It's okay, pal! Not everyone can have the perfect life!
Ohoh!
Psst, brother!
Can you scratch my head? It's started to itch!
My wife used to scratch it, but she's busy now!
Help a brother out, would you?
I will host a tea party with my wife to celebrate our anniversary!
Care to join us?
My venue of choice is... Right here!
Do join us! Ahh... Excellent!
It feels so good.
The longer I sit, the more comfortable I feel!
I never want to leave!
Ohh, where is she?
I have waited for so long now! It must be time for her to come!
Sometimes I think, "I can't just sit around while the demons are torturing my wife!"
Soon I will save her! She deserves nothing less! I will need to prepare...
Ahhh... I will be ready soon!
My wife is so beautiful! Ooh... Mmhh!
I can't wait until she comes to visit again! It's all I can think about!
I love her!
Some people go mad from being in this place!
Not me! Thanks to my wife I am so happy!
I love my wife!
I need my wife now, I can barely hold it anymore!
If she could just show herself..! Oohhh Ohh!
Ahhhh. She just left...
This will keep me going until our next date, for sure!
Life is all about the small pleasures.
And the big ones, oh yes!
Like when I meet my wife!
Ohhh! OOOHHHhh!
You just missed it, pal! She was here a moment ago!
Simply delightful!
You look like a dude on my wavelength!
Sure, take the hat, keep it bro!
What, you want this cool jacket too?
Well I gotta tell you, it's for true scholars only...
To really be part of this academy you first gotta prove you have an open mind!
Hmm...
Have you seen those nice mushrooms around this place?
They are hidden everywhere in this forest.
Yeah, that's your rite of initiation, man!
Bring me [gold_count] mushrooms and you'll be a true member of the forest scholars.
Before you go I gotta warn you! There is a dark hole over there...
Whatever you do, don't go near it!
Anyways my dude, better get started looking for those mushrooms!
Fellow free-thinker!
I gotta warn you...
Don't stare too long into that dark hole over there.
It's gonna start staring back!
I have seen many holes in my life, but that dark one over there is something else!
Looking at it you get this sudden urge to jump in...
It sounds crazy, I know dude!
What a strange phenomenon... Whoah...
I really enjoy this grove. Nice mushroom population... Comfortable and nice...
Have you tried out red mushrooms? They're pretty spicy!
If you find some white ones you gotta leave them to me though.
Yeah, you don't wanna eat those...
Way too spicy for a mere student like yourself!
You met my friend with the grey beard?
A true scholar, my hat goes off to him!
Wait! -
Did you hear that, dude?
That dark hole is calling...
I can't believe that thing!
I've said I will never ever place as much as a single toe in that void!
The veggies and mushooms around here and myself are like a big family.
Yeah, I hug trees. I love them!
Don't give me that look!
Anyways, we all agreed that dark hole is not allowed in our community!
It looks suspicious...
I've thought about dumping all the bad and unusable shrooms into the hole...
Hmm...
How about you toss these when you're over there anyway?
No?
Darkness is a solid, not merely the absence of light!
Considering The Hole, it's obvious...
Ah yes...
Remember to do your own research, my man!
The dark hole is at least as dark as the night sky itself!
Whoa... This is groundbreaking...
Hole and Night Sky, made from the same material?
Damn... Interesting...
I love this dirt...
Reminds me of that old fairy tale.
It's warm and fertile, you know?
Can you feel the dark hole?
It's sucking at me, dude... Just look at it!
Ever since I figured out its secrets!
It wants to get rid of me...
But the truth will spread! Yeah, bro, I'm gonna make sure of it.
Just one more nibble on this mushroom first...
The ground and mud is a place for mushrooms, and veggies.
Therefore ground and solid is the origin of life.
It follows that the empty air of the dark hole is the origin of death.
Indeed... Just as I suspected.
It's like that dark hole over there is staring at me, man!
I don't like the look that dark hole is giving me bro... Totally messes up my moustache!
That dark hole over there looks like it's up to something..!
That dark hole... It's just... Whoah... Mind-boggling...
How amusing, he approaches without shaking...
He should know he is fortunate... Weaker men have not been as lucky.
By his stance we see him as our like - a being of absolute will...
To prove that we are not mistaken, he will deliver us the Blood Red Stone.
The weak witless mass are fit only to be commanded.
But we are the higher kind, masters of will. We rule by right of might and determination alone.
Will he prove himself as one who has risen above?
Out of the men from the muddy below, some rise and stand out for brief moments in time.
Yet they all break at some point, we have known it.
Will he be yet another in the tale of failures that is mankind?
They meander through their lives with no direction nor control,
never grasping how pitifully weak their will is and the meaninglessness of their squirming - until they reach their end.
Man has a propensity for clouding their mind with hollow temptations.
Swaying to and fro between useless addictions they move ever closer to their final end.
Will he prove to us his freedom from this rot?
The fate of mankind is to be ruled over by supreme beings such as us.
But those who rise above the great unwashed, can we still call them men? Or have they become something greater?
